Address it by `path` ("tag/path/slug", exactly the `path` or `url` a listing returns), or by `tagPath` + `slug`; a category's own path reads its hub article. Not a title. tools.name: get_pages
tools.description: Batch read: 1 to 20 pages of the AcuiQ reference wiki in full in one call, which is how to read search or listing results. Pass `paths` as the listings return them. Paths that do not exist come back in `missing` rather than failing the call, anything past 20 in `remaining`, and pages past `maxChars`

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Browse the AcuiQ reference wiki by tag path rather than by keyword: every page under a branch, newest first by default. `tagPath` matches the branch and everything beneath it; omit it to walk the whole wiki. Sort by title for an A–Z pass. Same rows as search_wiki, with `totalPages`, `hasMore` and `n

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: The category tree of the AcuiQ reference wiki, the cheapest way to orient before searching. Each node carries its `path` (a tagPath list_pages and search_wiki take), name, description, `pageCount` (pages filed at that path) and `pageCountDeep` (with every descendant). `tagPaths` lists every tag path

tools.name: get_page_history
tools.description: A page's revisions in the AcuiQ reference wiki, newest first: each one's `id`, version, change type, message, date and the blocks it changed. Address the page as get_page does. A revision `id` is what a restore takes, where this server has one. Defaults: limit 20 (max 100).

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the maintainers of AcuiQ what you needed and did not find, what is wrong, or what broke. One issue per call, in 300 characters at most. Reports are read, not published.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_meridians, get_symptom_detail, get_point, create_checkout, get_order, search_wiki, get_page, get_page_history, send_feedback · Private data: get_meridians, get_full_corpus · Public sink: get_meridians, get_order, get_page, send_feedback · Destructive: search_wiki.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_meridians, get_symptom_detail, get_point, create_checkout, get_order, search_wiki, get_page, get_page_history, send_feedback · Private data: get_meridians, get_full_corpus · Public sink: get_meridians, get_order, get_page, send_feedback · Destructive: search_wiki

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_wiki" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
